summary: New nether biomes don t work properly in buffet worlds
description: The bug The new nether biomes (nether wastes, soul sand valley, crimson forest, warped forest and basalt deltas) do not work in Surface or Floating Island Buffet worlds. To reproduce - Create New World - Select More World Options - Make a buffet world - Select Soul Sand Valley - Set terrain type to Floating Islands or Surface Floating Island mode Freezes the game before it even loads terrain (Image Below) -Surface mode creates a purely ocean world (This happened the first time i tried to make one but works fine now for some reason) The following list is updated in version 20w15a: Biomes All world generators that freeze the game Nether wastes Surface Crimson forest Surface Warped forest Surface and floating islands Soul sand valley Surface Basalt deltas Surface
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft.
2. Create a new world by selecting "Create New World".
3. Click on "More World Options" before confirming the world creation.
4. Select “Buffet” as the world type.
5. Choose any of the following biomes: Nether Wastes, Soul Sand Valley, Crimson Forest, Warped Forest, or Basalt Deltas.
6. Set the terrain type to either Floating Islands or Surface Floating Island mode.
7. Confirm and start the new world.
8. Observe that the game freezes before loading the terrain.
9. Take a screenshot or record the issue for documentation.

10. Alternatively, observe that in Surface mode, the generated world is purely oceanic instead of the selected Nether biome.
Observed Behavior: The new nether biomes (Nether Wastes, Soul Sand Valley, Crimson Forest, Warped Forest, and Basalt Deltas) do not function properly in Surface or Floating Island Buffet worlds. To reproduce this issue, create a new world, select More World Options, choose to make a buffet world, pick Soul Sand Valley as the biome, and set the terrain type to either Floating Islands or Surface Floating Island mode. This configuration causes the game to freeze before it even loads terrain. In Surface mode, it creates a purely oceanic world, although this behavior has occasionally resolved itself for some users. The affected biomes include Nether Wastes, Crimson Forest, Warped Forest, and Basalt Deltas in both surface and floating island modes, while Soul Sand Valley is impacted only on the surface.
Expected Behavior: When creating a new buffet world with any of the Nether biomes (Nether Wastes, Soul Sand Valley, Crimson Forest, Warped Forest, Basalt Deltas) and setting the terrain type to Floating Islands or Surface mode, the game should generate the selected biome correctly without freezing or creating an ocean world. The expected behavior is that the chosen Nether biome features, including unique blocks and structures, should properly appear in the specified terrain type, allowing for normal gameplay and exploration.
